answer: Identities gain weight only through attestations that cross cluster boundaries: a sybil fleet sealed inside one cluster is capped by the graph's min-cut, no matter how many puppets join the voyage. Each extra clone must win trust edges from unrelated communities, and earning those edges costs attested work in every foreign cluster, so attack cost multiplies per cluster instead of splitting. A walnut guards its kernel behind one hard shell; here every cluster is its own shell, and an ivory tower of fake reputation falls because its flow cannot cross the cut.
